disclaimer: Ilya Aleksandrovich Boykov is a Russian national, not a DPRK national, and is profiled here as the cryptocurrency exchanger the Treasury says has supported Limited Liability Company Alis, the Russia-based DPRK IT worker company Kim Ki Hyok leads. OFAC's entry lists two Ethereum and two TRON addresses, which the scraper carries; one Ethereum address is listed for Vitold Viktorovich Obertas as well.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
name_korean_not_applicable: Russian national and cryptocurrency facilitator rather than a DPRK national, so no Korean rendering of the name applies.
